profile.name: Yousof Ghalenoei
profile.tagline: Bridging message passing, molecules, and machines.
bio: I am an AI researcher and engineer with a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, focused on the intersection of probabilistic inference, graph-structured data, and computational science. My work spans Approximate Message Passing (AMP), Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Kalman filtering, and generative models applied to drug design, metabolic engineering, material informatics, and autonomous AI agents.

I believe the most impactful machine learning is built on a strong foundation of statistics, optimization, and domain science. My research style combines rigorous theory with shipping practical systems — from high-dimensional sparse recovery to end-to-end molecular property pipelines and literature-mining agent workflows.
I am actively looking for PhD positions, research collaborations, and consulting engagements where I can push the boundaries of learning on scientific data.
profile.focus: Currently: diffusion-based molecular generation + AMP-inspired graph architectures, and agentic literature systems for metabolic engineering.

education.title: M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence
education.detail: Thesis: “Message Passing and Graph Neural Networks for High-Dimensional Inference.” Advisor: Prof. Hadi Sadoghi Yazdi. Coursework in probabilistic graphical models, high-dimensional statistics, reinforcement learning, and advanced deep learning.

education.title: B.Sc. in Computer Engineering
education.detail: Graduated with honors (Top 3%). Focus on algorithms, linear algebra, and signal processing. Final project on dictionary learning for time-series pattern recognition.

experience.title: Research Assistant — Sparse Inference Lab
experience.detail: Designing AMP-based iterative algorithms and GNN message-passing layers for compressed sensing and molecular property regression. Built GPU-accelerated PyTorch prototypes; results under review at a top ML venue.

experience.title: Machine Learning Engineer (part-time)
experience.detail: Own the ADMET property-prediction pipeline (RDKit descriptors + GNN ensembles). Delivered a 2× speedup in virtual screening throughput and a retrosynthesis planning prototype used by the discovery team.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant — Machine Learning

experience.title: Freelance Data Scientist / ML Engineer
experience.detail: Delivered time-series forecasting, sensor-fusion (Kalman/EKF) and anomaly-detection systems for industrial clients across logistics and manufacturing.

projects.title: GAMP-GNN
projects.subtitle: Message Passing for Model-Based Compressed Sensing
projects.summary: A hybrid approximate-message-passing network that unfolds GAMP iterations into a GNN, learning structured priors for high-dimensional sparse recovery with provably faster convergence.

projects.title: DiffMolecule
projects.subtitle: Guided Diffusion over Graphs for De Novo Drug Design
projects.summary: An equivariant diffusion model generating valid, synthesizable molecules under target-aware guidance, with RDKit-based property filters and a fragment-level latent space.

projects.title: MetFlux-GNN
projects.subtitle: Graph-Regularized Flux Prediction in Genome-Scale Models
projects.summary: Predicts metabolic flux distributions from transcriptomic priors by regularizing a GNN over the metabolic reaction network — beating FBA baselines on 12 curated strains.

projects.title: CrystalFormer
projects.subtitle: Bond-Aware Transformer for Inorganic Property Prediction
projects.summary: A Transformer with bond-aware attention and periodic-boundary embeddings predicting band gaps and formation energies from crystal structures.

projects.title: Invariant Kalman Filter
projects.subtitle: Lie-group EKF with Learned Noise Models
projects.summary: Invariant extended Kalman filtering on SE(3) for multi-sensor fusion (IMU + GNSS + odometry), with neural noise estimation improving RMSE by 34% on urban trajectories.

projects.title: Agentic-RAG
projects.subtitle: Self-Verifying Retrieval Agents for Scientific Literature
projects.summary: A multi-agent pipeline that plans retrieval queries, reads and cross-verifies claims across papers, and builds a provenance graph — built for metabolic-engineering literature review.
